publicLabelEs: Vía residual de restitución del art. 1535
coreProposition: Later title, financing and operation do not by themselves answer whether the upstream PH122-to-CAM credit position could have been extinguished under Article 1535 or what restorative consequence follows if effective exercise was frustrated.

statutoryBoundary.effect: Extinguishment of a qualifying sold litigious credit by reimbursing the assignee the price paid, qualifying costs and interest; not subrogatory acquisition of the credit.
statutoryBoundary.trigger: Nine days from the assignee's demand for payment.
statutoryBoundary.caducityBoundary: Supreme Court authority treats the nine-day period as caducity and therefore not ordinarily interruptible by preservation activity that is not effective exercise.
statutoryBoundary.strictness: Article 1535 is interpreted strictly and depends on the qualifying controversy, transfer form, timing and other statutory requirements.

reserveForms.proposition: No qualifying payment demand validly triggered the nine-day period, or another legally sufficient basis leaves literal Article 1535 exercise available.

Literal exercise is disputed or impossible, but a court may need to determine whether LPB should be restored to the economic/juridical position it would have occupied if the Article 1535 opportunity was unlawfully or ineffectively frustrated.

If the original credit was transformed or consumed, the relevant remedy may shift to tracing, restitution, unjust enrichment, ineffectiveness/nullity of dependent acts where legally available, or damages.

reverseEngineeringQuestion: If CAM's PH122 credit position is removed from the history at its original acquisition-cost basis through an assumed effective Article 1535 exercise, how much of the later route to the hotel survives independently?

proceduralPreservation.publicRule: Do not describe an established right to freeze the clock. Test whether declaratory or precautionary protection can preserve an unresolved statutory position before a fresh act arguably starts an irreversible period.
proceduralPreservation.criminalPrejudiciality: Article 40 LEC may matter where an existing criminal case investigates facts underlying the civil claim and its determination may decisively affect the civil outcome; it is not an automatic tolling rule.
